hook.doc: Cold open: photo cutout + headline + giant number + news clipping.

statement.doc: One big idea in type. text: 'line one | line two' (| = line break, revealed line by line), *word* = highlight. bg: paper|ink|accent|yellow.

end.doc: End screen with YouTube end-screen slots.

stat.doc: 1-3 numbers that count up. items: [{value: '₹41,000 Cr', label, icon, color, at}] or value+label.

bars.doc: Vertical bars. data: {FY21: 1122, FY22: 2094} or [{label, value, at, color}]. highlight: 'last' (default) | 'max' | label | false. note: 'text' or {text, at}.

hbars.doc: Ranked horizontal bars. data rows may carry img (logo name) and color.

line.doc: Line drawn over time. data: {2019: 10, 2020: 14} or series: {Zepto: {...}, Blinkit: {...}}. events: [{x: '2020', text, at}].

donut.doc: Shares of a whole. data: {Blinkit: 46, Zepto: 29, Instamart: 25}.

units.doc: Icon grid: value of total filled (e.g. 7 of 10 startups fail).

compare.doc: A vs B. a/b: {name, img, color}. rows: [['Delivery', '10 min', '30 min', 'a'], {label, a, b, win, at}].

map.doc: India map (official boundaries). states: ['Maharashtra'], cities: ['Mumbai', {name, label, value, at, lat, lon}], routes: [['Mumbai','Delhi']], count: {value, label, at}.

timeline.doc: items: [{year: '2021', text, icon, img, at, hi: true}]. >4 items pans along.

photo.doc: Big taped photo + notes [{text, x: 0-100, y: 0-100, circle: true, at}] pointing at spots; frame: 'full' = full-bleed duotone + caption.

headlines.doc: Real news headlines as clippings: items [{source: 'Economic Times', date: 'Jun 2024', text, at}] (max 4).

logos.doc: Logo wall: items ['Swiggy', {name, img, color, sub, cross: true|'word', at}].

flow.doc: How money/goods move: steps [{label, icon, img, sub, edge: 'label on the arrow after me', at}] 2-5; a token icon travels the chain.

phone.doc: Phone mockup: screen (screenshot image) or cards [{title, text, icon, color, at}] + points beside it.

people.doc: Characters in a set (store|office|street|city|home|stage|plain). cast: [{id, preset, x, pose, face, flip, prop, tag, enter, look}], do: [{who, at, pose, face, say, move, prop}].

ride.doc: Vehicle crosses an isometric city from A to B, camera following. vehicle: scooter|bike|car|auto|van|truck|bus. from/to: {label, kind: darkstore|shop|kirana|restaurant|warehouse|factory|home|tower|office|bank, icon}. at: [depart cue, arrive cue]. timer: '10 min' (counts up while riding) or false. dist: '2.1 km'. done: arrival stamp text. city: city|suburb.

cutaway.doc: Building whose front walls drop and roof lifts to show the inside working. kind: darkstore|warehouse|factory|kitchen|office|kirana. at: open cue. labels: [{text, zone, at}] (zones: darkstore shelves/packing/dispatch/pickers, warehouse racks/dock/staff, factory line/machines/workers, kitchen stoves/counter/chefs, office team, kirana shelves/counter/customers). orders: 4 or [{text, title, at}] phone notifications. count: {value, label, at}.

network.doc: City from above; stores pop up with delivery-radius rings and riders zipping out. stores: 8 or [{label, at, kind}]. kind: darkstore|shop|restaurant|warehouse... radius: '2 km'. riders per store (2). count: {value, label, at}. city: city|suburb.

cash.doc: Money in motion. mode: grow (stacks pile up) | burn (pile burns, smoke; cash burn / losses) | flow (coins arc from `from` to `to` nodes: {label, kind}). value+label: corner counter (counts). token: coin|cash. edge: label over the flow. at: start cue.

chain.doc: Supply chain on a road: steps [{kind: farm|factory|warehouse|darkstore|shop|restaurant|home|bank|office|phone|tower, label, sub, icon, edge: 'text on the road after me', vehicle, at}] 2-5; vehicles carry goods node to node, camera pans. token: cash adds a coin on each vehicle.

iso.doc: Free-form isometric world. world: {kind: city|suburb|plain, cols, rows, traffic, people}. place: [{id, model, block: [i, j], label, hi, h, color, at}]. move: [{model, from: id, to: id, at: [go, arrive], label, color}]. cam: {zoom, follow: move index}.
